articles.headline: ASU hockey coach placed on leave amid player collapse inquiry
articles.description: Arizona State hockey coach Greg Powers has been placed on paid administrative leave days after several members of his team asked the university to remove him pending an investigation into a teammate's collapse.

articles.headline: Matthew Mayich's parents want ASU coaches to be put on leave
articles.description: The parents of Matthew Mayich, the Arizona State hockey player who collapsed during an outdoor workout last month, are calling for the coaches involved to be removed until an independent investigation is completed.

articles.headline: ASU hockey players dispute school review of teammate's collapse
articles.description: Seven Arizona State hockey players disputed the university's review of a teammate's collapse and called for the school to put athletic staff on leave pending an independent investigation, according to a letter sent to the university president Monday.

articles.headline: ASU report details lapses before hockey player's collapse
articles.description: Arizona State did not vet the training plan for the workout led by a former Green Beret, during which a hockey player collapsed last month, according to a preliminary report the university released Tuesday.

articles.headline: Attorney seeks 'impartial' police for ASU hockey player collapse probe
articles.description: The attorney representing the family of the Arizona State hockey player who collapsed during a workout has asked campus police to transfer its investigation to an impartial agency, according to a letter obtained by ESPN Thursday.

articles.headline: Former hockey players sue Michigan over alleged sexualized hazing
articles.description: Sixteen former Michigan hockey players sued the university Wednesday, alleging that the team's former coaches and other school leaders turned a blind eye to decades of ritualized hazing that was sexual in nature.
